fullPassage: Emphasizing speed over frequency can make sense in contexts where everyone is expected to plan around the timetable, including peak-only commute services and very long trips with low demand. In all other contexts, though, it seems to be a common motorist's error. Roads are there all the time, so their speed is the most important fact that distinguishes them. But transit is only there if it's coming soon. If you have a car, you can use a road whenever you want and experience its speed. But transit has to exist when you need it (span), and it needs to be coming soon (frequency). Otherwise, waiting time will wipe out any time savings from a faster service. Unless you're comfortable planning your life around a particular scheduled trip, speed is worthless without frequency, so a transit map that screams about speed and whispers about frequency may simply be planting confusion.

questions.stem: 윗글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 대부분의 다른 맥락에서 이것은 흔한 운전자의 오류(motorist's error)이다.
det.analysis:
✅ motorist's error(운전자의 오류): 도로 이용자의 관점으로 대중교통을 바라보는 실수
❌ traveler's dilemma(여행자의 딜레마): 원문과 다름
❌ commuter's habit(통근자의 습관): 습관이 아니라 오류
❌ passenger's choice(승객의 선택): 선택이 아니라 오류
det.tip: motorist's error = 운전자의 오류 (도로의 속도 개념을 대중교통에 적용하는 실수)

questions.passage: Emphasizing speed over frequency can make sense in contexts where everyone is expected to plan around the timetable, including peak-only commute services and very long trips with low demand. In all other contexts, though, it seems to be a common motorist's error. Roads are there all the time, so their speed is the most important fact that distinguishes them. But transit is only there if it's coming soon. If you have a car, you can use a road whenever you want and experience its speed. But transit has to exist when you need it (span), and it needs to be coming soon (frequency). Otherwise, waiting time will wipe out any time savings from a faster service. Unless you're comfortable planning your life around a particular scheduled trip, speed is worthless without frequency, so a transit map that screams about speed and whispers about frequency may simply be planting confusion.
questions.stem: 이 글에서 'span'이 의미하는 것으로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 대중교통이 필요할 때 존재해야(exist) 한다는 맥락에서 운행 시간대의 범위.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ 대중교통이 운행하는 시간대의 범위: transit has to exist when you need it (span)
❌ ①: 물리적 거리 아님
❌ ②: 건축물 아님
❌ ④: 전체 지속 시간이 아닌 운행 존재 시간
det.tip: span = transit가 exist해야 하는 시간의 폭
